verdict.rationale: Postmark is an email service with templates and webhooks, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. The evidence shows template create/edit, validation, and pushing templates to another server. None of this documents version history, change review, or rollback, so these features are adjacent rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
